stories.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define the allowlist structure mapping tool names to permitted handlers and associated Pydantic input models. Establish strict validation contract for tool name, arguments schema, and rejection behavior for non-allowlisted tools.

stories.title: Core Allowlist Dispatch Logic
stories.description: Implement backend routing logic that inspects incoming tool_use blocks, enforces allowlist membership, and dispatches only to approved handlers. Reject or safely handle unknown or disallowed tools per GOV-004.

stories.title: Pydantic Input Validation Integration
stories.description: Integrate Pydantic models for each allowlisted tool to validate input payloads prior to execution. Ensure validation errors are captured and returned in a controlled, non-breaking format.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration with Chat Loop
stories.description: Integrate allowlist router into the main FastAPI chat loop, including handling of Anthropic tool_use blocks, chat history injection, and safe execution flow across domain services.

stories.title: Allowlist Routing Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlisted tool execution, rejection of unauthorized tools, Pydantic validation failures, and correct routing to domain services.
